evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Radial oblique tear of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus with mild extrusion.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment cartilage: Diffuse high-grade cartilage loss, weightbearing portion of the femoral condyle.
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: Low-grade cartilage fraying spanning the lateral compartment.
evidence.PF OA: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Mild heterogeneity of the patellar cartilage.
evidence.Contusion: Findings may reflect contusion or severe osseous stress response/developing stress fracture.
